title: Alaska Peninsula National Wildlife Refuge
summary: The Alaska National Interest Land Conservation Act established Alaska Peninsula National Wildlife Refuge on December 2, 1980. Sandwiched between Becharof National Wildlife Refuge to the north and Izembek National Wildlife Refuge to the south, this refuge encompasses towering mountains, active volcanoes, broad valleys, fjords, tundra and glacially formed lakes.
